name_zh: 东姑阿都拉曼/马来西亚/独立/多元/联邦制/不结盟
description_zh: 东姑阿都拉曼（1903-1990），马来西亚首任首相（1957-1970），被尊称为'国父'。他在英国殖民统治下领导了和平独立的谈判，通过协商建立了马来西亚联邦制度，融合了马来人、华人和印度人的多元社会结构。他是不结盟运动的积极倡导者，也是东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）的创始人之一。东姑以温和务实的外交风格、对多元文化的尊重和对和平独立的追求著称。
description_en: Tunku Abdul Rahman (1903-1990), Malaysia's first Prime Minister (1957-1970), honored as the 'Father of Independence.' He led peaceful independence negotiations under British colonial rule, establishing a Malaysian federal system that integrated the plural social structures of Malays, Chinese, and Indians. He was an active advocate of the Non-Aligned Movement and one of the founding members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN). Tunku was known for his moderate and pragmatic diplomatic style, respect for multiculturalism, and pursuit of peaceful independence.
reason_zh: 东姑阿都拉曼代表了东南亚后殖民时代通过和平谈判实现独立的典范。他巧妙平衡了多元族群利益，建立了联邦制国家框架，奠定了马来西亚多元社会共存的基础。作为东盟创始人和不结盟运动成员，他的外交智慧对东南亚区域合作产生了深远影响。
reason_en: Tunku Abdul Rahman represents the paradigm of achieving independence through peaceful negotiations in post-colonial Southeast Asia. He skillfully balanced plural ethnic interests, establishing a federal state framework that laid the foundation for Malaysia's multicultural coexistence. As an ASEAN founder and Non-Aligned Movement member, his diplomatic wisdom had a profound impact on Southeast Asian regional cooperation.
steps_zh: 研究东姑阿都拉曼在英国剑桥大学的法学教育及其政治觉醒
分析1946-1955年领导马来亚联合邦独立谈判的和平斗争策略
探讨1957年8月31日马来亚独立宣言的历史意义与联邦制度设计
评估1963年马来西亚联邦成立及与新加坡合并的政治决策
总结1957年发起不结盟运动、1967年参与创立东盟的外交遗产
steps_en: Study Tunku Abdul Rahman's legal education at Cambridge University and his political awakening
Analyze the peaceful struggle strategy of leading Malaya's independence negotiations from 1946-1955
Explore the historical significance and federal system design of the August 31, 1957 Malaya independence declaration
Evaluate the political decision of the 1963 Malaysian Federation establishment and merger with Singapore
Summarize his diplomatic legacy of initiating the Non-Aligned Movement in 1957 and co-founding ASEAN in 1967
expected_zh: 掌握东姑阿都拉曼作为马来西亚国父的和平建国理念，理解多元族群社会的联邦制治理模式，评估其对东南亚区域合作（东盟）和不结盟运动的贡献。
expected_en: Master Tunku Abdul Rahman's peaceful nation-building philosophy as Malaysia's Father of Independence, understand the federal governance model of multicultural societies, and evaluate his contributions to Southeast Asian regional cooperation (ASEAN) and the Non-Aligned Movement.
case_zh: 1957年8月31日，东姑阿都拉曼在吉隆坡武吉免登体育场挥动拳头高呼'Merdeka!'（独立），宣布马来亚联合邦正式脱离英国殖民统治获得独立。随后在1963年推动成立马来西亚联邦，将马来亚、新加坡、沙巴和砂拉越联合为一个国家。1957年发起不结盟运动，主张中小国家在大国博弈中保持独立外交立场。1967年参与签署《曼谷宣言》，成为东盟五创始国之一。
case_en: On August 31, 1957, Tunku Abdul Rahman waved his fist at Bukit Jalil Stadium in Kuala Lumpur shouting 'Merdeka!' (Independence), declaring the Federation of Malaya's formal independence from British colonial rule. Subsequently in 1963, he promoted the establishment of the Malaysian Federation, uniting Malaya, Singapore, Sabah, and Sarawak into one nation. In 1957 he initiated the Non-Aligned Movement, advocating that small and medium countries maintain independent diplomatic stances amid great power competition. In 1967, he participated in signing the Bangkok Declaration, becoming one of ASEAN's five founding members.
cross_cultural_impact: Southeast Asian independence leader, ASEAN founding father, Non-Aligned Movement advocate
